entities.summary: The Treaty of Bakhchisarai or Treaty of Radzin, was signed in Bakhchysarai, which ended the Russo-Turkish War (1676–1681), on 3 January 1681 by Russia, the Ottoman Empire, and the Crimean Khanate.
